alex chen: hi — quick Q. I have an IEP meeting for my kid next Wed 9am. I'm on a 4hr phased return schedule. can I shift hours or use intermittent leave for that slot?
michelle (People Ops): yes you can. two easy paths: swap your schedule with your manager for that day, or file intermittent family leave for the appointment. either is fine — we cover short IEP appts. :white_check_mark:
alex chen: thanks! any docs i need to submit? payroll runs soon so want to make sure it's coded correctly.
ash (Benefits): if it's under 4 hours, you can use intermittent FLA (select "child education appointment") or take PTO. if >4 hours we treat as a short day. add a quick note to the leave form.
michelle (People Ops): michelle here — please use the IEP appointment form so we have documentation for accommodations. link: https://intranet.redwood/care/iep-request 
people-ops-bot: FYI submitted forms should include: child name, school, date/time, expected duration, and whether you'll be remote/hybrid that day. Template: ```Child: Maya Chen
School: Riverbend Elem
Date/time: 2026-04-01 09:00-10:00
Duration: 1 hour
Request: shift hours earlier that day to 11am-3pm
```
alex chen: got it. if tara approves the swap do i still need to file the form?
tara (Manager): you should file the form for our records but i'll approve the swap in the schedule. tag me in the form and i'll confirm. :+1:
nash (Benefits): payroll note: code as "Intermittent FLA" for unpaid leave or as "PTO" if you elect paid time. benefits coverage unaffected.
alex chen: one more — i'm on a L1 visa. does that change anything for international employees?
michelle (People Ops): good call — for visa folks we recommend documenting time-off but it's the same process. if travel to another country is involved, loop in Legal.
nash (Benefits): also if you need proof for the school (IEP docs) we can provide a standard employer verification letter — ping me and we can draft it.
alex chen: amazing, thanks everyone. I'll file the form now and tag tara. much appreciated. :pray:
